kind: pre-gate hard draw (selection only: no program run, no model called)
rule: drop coding tasks with no test data
drop coding tasks rated outside [1600, inf]
drop faults with fewer than 1 sibling wrong submissions (after the shuffle, so the constraint is additive)
drop faults whose source exceeds 48000 characters (the proposer could not emit a rewrite that long)
keep the first fault of each coding task
first 120 of that walk = corpus; the rest = reserve
gates_not_yet_applied: stage 1 usability (reference passes; fault exposed; no timeout)
stage 2 natural-mutant gate (>= 2/3 of the scoreable siblings caught)
